method: Static gravity projection at the seat, rigid sweep of the whole seated pipe from its carry seat toward each opening against every other reserve, and the free-piece receive, receive-and-go and sled trials (evidence/field-trials.json: stick-slip friction, so a seated pipe holds statically) for dynamic capture, power loss and the isolation of each retaining member.

pushBack: lower and upper treads under the powered hold (front)
check flap and its rear stop (rear)
side walls 10.2 mm from the pipe ends (+/-Y)

forward (+X) into the nip.note: no rigid obstruction within 400 mm: the rigid roller cores clear the pipe through the throat; the forward stop is the compliant tread squeeze under the powered hold, qualified by the receive and sled trials

powerOff.holder: None needed: with the robot disabled the nip is back-drivable through the 36:1 gearbox and the reflected motor inertia; the pipe must still climb the 12 mm squeeze to leave

escapeControl.result: check flap removed: 8 g toward the inlet from a gently settled seat 1/2 retained; receive and go 0/2 retained
escapeControl.firstOpening: rearward up the floor toward the inlet

isolation.drive: Powered hold: 108/108 receives seat over 40-160 N/mm. Robot disabled: 4/4 receives seat and 18/18 sled pulses are retained. The layout-001 worm lock seats 4/4: the lock adds nothing the powered hold and the gearbox do not give.
isolation.flap: No flap from the received seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 1/2; from a gently settled seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 1/2; receive and go without it: 0/2 retained
isolation.hood: No hood: 4/4 receives seat; no flare: 4/4; peak rise with both 4.49 mm. Not shown to earn their place in the planar model.
isolation.tread: 10 N/mm: 9/12 receives seat; 20 N/mm 12/12; 30 N/mm 12/12; 40-160 N/mm 108/108 with tread mu 0.3-1.0.

findings.text: Tread stiffness decides receive custody: fails at 10 N/mm, passes from 20 N/mm, accepted band 40-120 N/mm per roller. No supplier publishes it; G0 measures the installed stack and sets the wheel count.
Carry custody rests on the flap for rearward loads and the powered hold and squeeze for forward loads; model: 72/72 powered and 18/18 disabled sled cases retained at 1-8 g.

findings.status: closed in this layout; bench gate G5
findings.text: Seated-pipe beam, flap-closed switch, lip-deployed switch and reef range sensor are selected and placed.
